description:
The Basics

Tanium is looking for a Security Engineer to join the R&D Security organization, which protects the software and cloud services our customers depend on.

Tanium’s customers secure some of the most consequential networks in the world, and they extend us a great deal of trust. Earning that trust means ensuring that the software we build and ship, as well as the systems and processes used to produce it, are secure from the first commit to the final release.

In this role, you will build software and automation that integrate security throughout the software development lifecycle. You will help identify vulnerabilities in our products, secure our development and build environments, and manage risks from third-party components. Working closely with R&D Security and Engineering, you will combine automated controls with hands-on reviews to find and address risks early, prevent unacceptable risk from reaching customers, and continuously monitor for emerging threats.

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain security tooling and services as production software, leveraging AI and agentic workflows where possible to automate security processes.
  • Integrate security checks into development and release workflows, providing actionable feedback early and enforcing appropriate security requirements before software reaches customers.
  • Expand and measure security coverage across production code, dependencies, repositories, build pipelines, and development infrastructure.
  • Select and tune security checks to balance coverage and accuracy, reduce false positives, and identify gaps in detection. Run checks at appropriate points and frequencies, combining change-triggered reviews, release checks, and continuous monitoring.
  • Implement risk-based release gates and reliable alerting so that blocked releases have a clear reason, an accountable owner, and an actionable path to resolution.
  • Harden source repositories, build pipelines, and development environments by establishing secure configurations and automatically detecting or preventing drift.
  • Evaluate and manage risks from open-source and third-party software, including AI artifacts such as models, agent skills, and plugins, used in development or incorporated into our products.
  • Conduct manual security reviews where needed, including design reviews, threat modeling, code review, and targeted security testing.
  • Investigate vulnerabilities and supply-chain threats, assess their impact, and partner with Engineering and other R&D Security teams to drive remediation and verify fixes.
  • Turn recurring findings into reusable checks, secure development guidance, and improvements to engineering workflows.
  • Partner with Engineering, DevOps, Cloud, IT, and GRC stakeholders to close security gaps and support compliance programs through documented, auditable controls.

We’re looking for someone with

  • Education
    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
    • CS Degree preferred
  • Experience
    • 3+ years industry experience, 5+ preferred
    • Experience in security engineering, product or application security, supply chain security, DevSecOps, or software engineering with a substantial security focus.
    • Strong security fundamentals, including common vulnerability classes, trust boundaries, authentication and authorization, secure design, and practical risk assessment.
    • Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Go, JavaScript, Python, or C++, and demonstrated ability to build maintainable, tested software and automation.
    • Experience with modern software development practices and tooling, including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code.
    • Hands-on experience securing software, development infrastructure, or build and release workflows.
    • Experience evaluating security tools, validating findings, and understanding detection limitations.
    • Ability to assess the severity, exploitability, and business impact of vulnerabilities and work with engineers to implement effective fixes.
  • Other
    • Experience securing AWS or Azure environments, containers, or Kubernetes.
    • Familiarity with artifact repositories, software composition analysis, software bills of materials, and third-party dependency risk management.
    • Experience building custom security checks, static analysis rules, or tooling that detects vulnerabilities across large codebases.
    • Experience designing security release gates, exception workflows, and operational alerting.
    • Experience applying AI and agentic workflows to security work, with sound judgment about their accuracy and limitations.
    • Knowledge of applied cryptography, including encryption, hashing, signing, and secure key management.
    • Contributions to open-source security tooling, published security research, credited CVEs, or conference talks.

About Tanium 

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. As Al accelerates both innovation and risk, Tanium Atlas, the company's autonomous operating system, puts the full depth of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform behind every IT and security operator - human and agentic. Tanium provides the real-time intelligence, agentic decision-making, and autonomous execution operators needed to detect, decide, and remediate at machine speed across their endpoint estate. 

The company is recognized as a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Management Tools, as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Client Endpoint Management Software for Windows Device Management 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment, and as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™. Endpoint Management Platforms, Q2 2026.

To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business, visit www.tanium.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

On a mission. Together. 

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.   

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.  

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work. 

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.   

What you’ll get 

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $154,000 to $236,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact accommodations@tanium.com. For more information refer to the “Know Your Rights” poster which is available here - https://www.eeoc.gov/poster.

Please be aware of job offers coming from people claiming to be Tanium employees. Tanium employees will only use @tanium.com email addresses to communicate with you, will have video interviews with you, and will never ask you for money.
